rules: Strategies pre-defined using position, signs, smallest/middle/largest magnitudes or raw copying, evaluated overall, per visible differing-coordinate template, per first-pivot sign and per presence of unit row. Magnitude rank uses choices only; it never reads input coefficient magnitudes. Unknown prediction counts as wrong. Chance baseline is 1/5. Exact batch assessed separately; singleton conditional hits are descriptive, not a learned reliable predictor.
construction_analysis: correct_index is drawn from all five before independently sampling distinct candidate magnitudes, signs and row scales. Fixed-bank tests rotate every candidate through correctness for each template and band. No tested incidental cue determines the response family-wide. First/second/third-row unit copying is mathematical use of an already normalized source row, not a defect.
